facts.fact: Marracuene, in Maputo province, became the first municipality in the country to start postal addressing (naming and numbering streets and buildings, postal codes, toponymic signs and a geographic database), launched on 3 October 2025 by the Ministry of State Administration and Public Service under Decree 74/2024, the Jornal NGANI reports.
